title: Local segment failure outcome

source.anchor: ### Requirement: UIREQ-019 Local segment failure outcome

requirement: WHEN a future financial segment fails locally, the adapter SHALL distinguish its discarded tentative delta from the retained committed prefix, consumed work and residual duties.
expectedSource: spec text only; no expectation was derived from implementation behavior

scenarios.name: Second segment fails before commit
scenarios.when: After the 68-reserve/10-liability prefix, a later local segment fails before its financial commit.
scenarios.then: The retained prefix still reports reserve 68 and liability 10, plus later consumed work; no global ledger rollback is inferred.
